mapper.select: SELECT * FROM trade_payment WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE trade_payment SET status = 2, channel_trade_no = #{channelTradeNo}, notify_id = #{notifyId}, paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), next_reconcile_at = NULL, last_reconcile_error = NULL WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status IN (0, 1, 3)
